recipes.r-planks: Planks from a log: one log makes four planks.
recipes.r-sticks: Sticks from two planks stacked in a column: four sticks.
recipes.r-crafting_table: A crafting table from a two-by-two square of planks.
recipes.r-slab: Slabs from a row of three planks: six slabs.
recipes.r-wooden_pickaxe: A pickaxe: three planks across the top and two sticks down the centre.
recipes.r-stone_pickaxe: A pickaxe: three cobblestone across the top and two sticks down the centre.
recipes.r-iron_pickaxe: A pickaxe: three iron ingots across the top and two sticks down the centre.
recipes.r-wooden_sword: A sword: two planks in a column over a stick.
recipes.r-stone_sword: A sword: two cobblestone in a column over a stick.
recipes.r-iron_sword: A sword: two iron ingots in a column over a stick.

omissions: Gathering raw materials: the stock is given
Recipes whose shape the game accepts mirrored (axes and hoes)
Recipes that accept any of several materials: oak stands for every kind of wood
Recipes that differ between versions of the game
